title: Bacteriophages discovered
summary: Frederick Twort was the original discoverer, in 1915, of bacteriophages: viruses that infect bacteria.
why: Phages later became central to molecular biology and phage therapy.

unsung.contribution: First discovered bacteriophages, viruses that infect bacteria.
unsung.recognition: His discovery was ignored; Felix d'Herelle found phages independently, and Twort's paper was rescued only by later rediscovery.
